release_summary:
Release 0.11.120: item links in chat answer clicks again after a Reload UI or character change, and right-clicking an item gives the game's Preview again.

Cherry's Chat 0.11.5, rom weakauras 0.9.34 and Ultimate Mail Mod 7.0.1-ck18: the addons that watch chat link clicks could wrap each other in a circle after a Reload UI or a character change, so item links in chat stopped answering until the game was restarted; a click that comes back round now goes straight on to the game. Cherry's Chat drops a saved click layout that never carried the link and learns only from the game's chat windows. Right-clicking an item link in Cherry's chat gives the game's own right-click (Preview for skins); names and plain text keep the copy menu. When the screen size or UI scale changes (the game window moved to another monitor), the chat text is measured and laid out again, and /cchat linkprobe reports where the last click landed and the link areas of that row. Unchanged addon packages keep their versions and files byte for byte.
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: 1616 tests; 1415 passed and 201 skipped (Windows PowerShell or retired), none failing. New tests load the real Ultimate Mail Mod and rom weakauras link hooks and reload them in both orders (the old code loops forever), and cover Cherry's Chat's right-click on items and names, a saved layout without the link, learning only from chat windows, re-watching after a reload, two links on one line and the click report. The release build verifies all 17 install packages, and every package that kept its version is byte for byte the one in 0.11.119, so setup and the Addons page offer exactly the changed ones. Not yet checked in game: CB7-CB10 in docs/TESTING.md, and the earlier open checks.

addons.title: Cherry's KittyCombo

its code boxes use Cherry's Chat's copy-box size

the Kitty mode shows on Cherry's Bar instead of its own plate

also: AddonManager lists it when you have that addon.

addons.title: rom weakauras

addons.title: Cherry's Chat

addons.title: zBag

works_with.for: Ctrl+click a name in chat to fill the mail's To

also: AddonManager lists it when you have that addon. Its libraries, LibStub and Sol, come with it.

standalone_packages.title: LogNextChar
standalone_packages.summary: Next and Prev buttons that log you straight into the neighbouring character, with its own login screen: gets past a stuck server list, saved logins, keyboard controls.

origin.note: Install login screen.bat, or the guided setup, moves those folders to `Interface\offloaded_addons` for you, along with `CherrysKit\CherrysLoginxmlHook` from before Cherry's Loginxml became part of this addon. The login screen itself is Rom Autologin by Pyrrhus with fixes, and has to live in `Interface\loginxml`, the only place the game reads one: the same installer updates what is there, copies the old folder to `Interface\offloaded_addons` first, and keeps your saved logins.

works_with.for: shows each character's gold and last save on the character screen and the helper's status on the server screen, and gives it your account's character list, which boxes them together on its page and fills in their servers
closes its window before switching characters, as it does the game's mail window

standalone_packages.after_install: close the game and run `!setup_cherryskit.bat`, or double-click `Interface\AddOns\CherrysKit\LogNextChar\Install login screen.bat`. The game only reads a login screen from `Interface\loginxml`, so this copies it there. Until then, Next and Prev only log you out.

external_packages.title: zMail
external_packages.summary: pyrr's mailbox addon, as an alternative to Ultimate Mail Mod. Its own folder Interface\AddOns\zmail, unchanged except one fix: mails with gold it can't take (gold cap) are no longer opened, so they keep their 30 days instead of 3.
external_packages.upstream: zMail 1.4 by pyrr (CurseForge). zMail is pyrr's project; Cherry's Kit has no connection with it other than distributing it, with pyrr's permission.
changes: src/inbox.lua: only read the attached item's count for mails without gold (data.money == 0), so mails with gold beyond the cap aren't opened.
data/chars.lua: shipped empty (the original listed test characters).
CHANGES.txt left out; CherrysKit-version.txt added so the setup can tell this copy from a CurseForge one.
